Maya Ortiz: Quick SEO ops for the launch/webinar: keywords, schema, internal linking, redirects, GTM. Who can pick owners?
Liam Cheng: I'll do keyword mapping + meta templates. One primary + two long-tail per page. Sheet by Tue.
Anton Varga: I'll handle redirects for 7 moved docs and provide Netlify + NGINX examples. Will stage as 302 then switch to 301.
Maya Ortiz: @Liam include UTM examples and anchor text suggestions for internal links. @Anton add curl status checks.
Liam Cheng: Keywords: landing primary "low-latency LLM inference"; supports "inference latency optimization","GPU inference serving". Webinar long-tails: "reduce inference cost","LLM serving webinar".
Anton Varga: NGINX example: rewrite ^/docs/old-guide/?$ /docs/platform/new-guide/ permanent;
Maya Ortiz: GTM/form: add hidden field campaign=llm_launch_apr and fire event webinar_reg. SalesOps wants lead_source and utm_content from benchmark blog.
seo-bot: Reminder: run Structured Data testing + Lighthouse on staging after schema goes live.
Maya Ortiz: Owners & deadlines: Liam -> keywords by Tue (1768080000). Anton -> redirect CSV + PR by Fri (1768339200). I'll schedule 20m review once assets are in. Ping here for blockers.
